name: Afghanistan
summary: Landlocked Central/South Asian mountainous country dominated by the Hindu Kush range. Severe winter household biomass and coal heating in high-altitude basins creates extreme localized air pollution.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 10.84x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Kabul mountain bowl traps winter coal, wood, and tire heating smoke.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; heightened drought frequency depletes Helmand and Hari river basins.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across Hindu Kush mountain stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.03% share of global emissions; minimal heavy industrial manufacturing.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Extremely low per capita emissions reflecting developing agrarian economy.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Severely degraded cedar and pine stands in eastern Nuristan covering ~12,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Domestic grid generation is hydro-dominated (Kajaki, Naghlu), but country relies heavily on electricity imports.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 65 people/km²; rural agrarian population fraction is 73.0%.
